expected.insightNarrative:
Commission Model is the Sales Commission Model dashboard: enter a new quota, the quota for bonus attainment, the base salary and the commission rate to estimate the compensation of each sales rep under those conditions. The dashboard is set to a new quota of $450K, a bonus for $10,000, a base salary of $30,000 and a commission rate of 5.0%.

Key insights
- Richard Martinez is the outlier on every measure: $1,144,601 in sales, 254% of quota achieved, $1,145K of estimated achievement, $57,230 in commission pay and $97,230 in total compensation, the highest on the team.
- Behind him, Robert Wilson reaches 224% of quota, James Williams 154% ($79K of compensation), John Jones 146% ($68K), Charles Lee and Ruth Hernandez 122% ($67K), Michael Moore and Sharon King 117% ($65K) and Patricia Johnson and Margaret White 106% ($63K, the on-target earnings).
- Carol Allen sits exactly at 100% of quota, while Nancy Garcia, Lisa Martin (93%), David Thompson, Barbara Davis (90%), Thomas Young and Joseph Hall (83%) fall short and earn $49K to $51K.

Types of Pay
The resulting totals across the sales team: total base pay $1,230K, commission pay $780K and total bonus compensation $130K.

Cost of Seller Pay
Seller pay as a percent of total sales is 13.7%, and incentive pay as a percent of compensation is 42.5%.

Sales Planning
Performance and compensation by sales rep under these conditions. The left bars show each rep's sales against the new quota of $450K, coloured by quota attainment (below 50%, 50-75%, 75-100%, 100%+); the right bars show total compensation split into base salary, commission and bonus pay, with on-target earnings of $63K marked. Richard Martinez leads with 224% attainment and $97K of compensation, followed by Robert Wilson, James Williams (154%, $79K), Elizabeth Miller and Jessica Baker ($74K), John Jones (146%, $68K), Charles Lee and Ruth Hernandez (122%, $67K), Michael Moore and Sharon King (117%, $65K), Patricia Johnson and Margaret White (106%, $63K); Carol Allen is at 100% and Nancy Garcia, Lisa Martin (93%), David Thompson, Barbara Davis (90%), Thomas Young and Joseph Hall (83%) fall short of quota, earning $49K to $51K.

Sheet 4
The title and the parameter controls at the top of the dashboard.
